agent_sessions_status_fields_valid.name: agent_sessions_status_fields_valid
agent_sessions_status_fields_valid.value:
(
        ("agent_sessions"."status" = 'running' and "agent_sessions"."ended_at" is null)
        or
        ("agent_sessions"."status" = 'ended' and "agent_sessions"."ended_at" is not null)
      )

agent_sessions_cwd_length_valid.name: agent_sessions_cwd_length_valid
agent_sessions_cwd_length_valid.value: "agent_sessions"."cwd" is null or char_length("agent_sessions"."cwd") between 1 and 1000

agent_sessions_model_length_valid.name: agent_sessions_model_length_valid
agent_sessions_model_length_valid.value: "agent_sessions"."model" is null or char_length("agent_sessions"."model") between 1 and 200

agent_usage_model_length_valid.name: agent_usage_model_length_valid
agent_usage_model_length_valid.value: "agent_usage"."model" is null or char_length("agent_usage"."model") between 1 and 200

agents_repo_root_length_valid.name: agents_repo_root_length_valid
agents_repo_root_length_valid.value: "agents"."repo_root" is null or char_length("agents"."repo_root") between 1 and 1000

agents_repo_key_length_valid.name: agents_repo_key_length_valid
agents_repo_key_length_valid.value: "agents"."repo_key" is null or char_length("agents"."repo_key") between 1 and 1005

shift_commits_branch_length_valid.name: shift_commits_branch_length_valid
shift_commits_branch_length_valid.value: "shift_commits"."branch" is null or char_length("shift_commits"."branch") between 1 and 500

time_sessions_status_fields_valid.name: time_sessions_status_fields_valid
time_sessions_status_fields_valid.value:
(
        ("time_sessions"."status" = 'running' and "time_sessions"."stopped_at" is null and "time_sessions"."duration_seconds" is null)
        or
        ("time_sessions"."status" in ('stopped', 'needs_review') and "time_sessions"."stopped_at" is not null and "time_sessions"."duration_seconds" is not null)
      )
